args.summary: Played to turn 86 as a conqueror. I queued swordsmen in several cities, took the Warlord virtue and declared war on Tiwanaku. No enemy ever showed up in about 15 end turns, so I got no battle. The "Choose production" prompt kept returning, and a stack of side prompts (Ruler, Empire, Cities) stayed open. The autosave worked. I looked at every checklist area at least briefly, but I never fought a battle or used the naval side.

thought: Wrapping up; the war never produced contact.

args.summary: Played gunpowder-age game. Siege defence with 400 militia against 40000 was hopeless, army wiped in seconds, laborers died, town hall falling. Quiet war turns felt slow; production times long (23 turns for musketeers). Ruler points and build menus worked fine. Tutorial hint skipping was fiddly and the begin button was partly covered by a banner.

thought: Battle lost, wrapping up the session.

args.summary: Played turns 151 to 160 of a long war as Tupinamba. Ending turns was quick and autosave worked. Each city asked for production again and again. Build times of 34 to 51 turns for rifle infantry and tanks felt far too slow even with 11k gold. I saw no real battle during this stretch. The war with Tiwanaku felt passive. Tanks were locked behind a tech, but the Research link made that clear.

thought: Wrapping up the session at the step limit.
